items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: most of the time I have to play like George Tate played.

ctx.x: Huh? How come you play this way on this particular record? I don't know, why you mean? Well, it sounds a little different than your other recordings, you know? Somehow the way you put it. Your tone and everything sounds a little different, don't you think? Your style's a little different, huh?
Well, I don't know, most of the time I have to play like George Tate played. I mean, so that... ...

... ... ... My mama told me she said, Stop, please stand on your lawn. She ain't no good. She better take all your money and give it to a sweet man. You know something, man? I'm one of those gals on his foot down. I'm going around there and call her just one more time. Gals on you. Gals on you. When they don't think it's all right, I love you. We love you, Jeff. I said. Friends about you, babe, because Gals on your real life. Oh. Is that the Magic College of Madison Square Garden?
